notes.title: Spark in the Dark – Demo Update & Road to Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We're excited to share a new update for the Spark in the Dark demo, featuring new mechanics, improvements, and many fixes.

This is the final major update for the demo. The next big step is the Early Access release, planned for Q1 2026.
In Early Access, all three Dungeon tiers will be available. Our team is currently focused on finishing the second and third tiers, along with refining the core game systems.

Spark in the Dark Update 0.017
Save System
Your progress is now saved when resting at a campfire. You can exit the game and return later to continue right where you left off.
If your hero dies permanently, the save file is deleted.

Revival in Monster Lairs
After death, the hero now has a chance to wake up in a monster lair.
The system considers which monsters were nearby at the moment of death, as well as the distance and accessibility of their lairs.
The hero revives with injuries (the number depends on the difficulty level) and lies still. Monsters ignore him until he gets up — giving the player a chance to choose the right moment to escape.
It’s a small but meaningful second chance after death.

Dagger Throwing
The hero can now throw daggers.
They bounce off hard surfaces, stick into wood, and stay lodged in enemies — you can recover them after a fight.
Initially available to the Thief and Warrior, other classes can learn this skill by finding a skill book.

Ancient Shields and New Enhancements
Ancient shields have been reworked and new types have been added with varying weight and durability.
Shields can now have the following enhancements:

 Reinforced Base — extra protection
 Sturdy Straps — resistance to knockback
 Leather Padding — reduced stamina cost

Some shields also feature a spike that deals small damage to monsters when they hit the shield — unless they attack with a weapon.

Spiders and Webs
Sometimes, after a spider dies, you may find that its abdomen has burst open — and small spiderlings have crawled out.
Also, stepping into active webs now not only slows the hero but attracts nearby spiders.

Campfire Nightmares
If the hero has absorbed too much Darkness in the Dungeon, nightmares may appear during rest.
Drinking by the fire can reduce the chance of nightmares — but drinking too much may cause a hangover.
New hero voice lines at the campfire have also been added.

Armor Repair and Equipment Wear

 Armor repair benches have been added and can be used outside of camp.
 Weapons can now break permanently if not repaired in time.
 Crossbows wear down with use and can be repaired just like lanterns.

Storage and Inventory
You can now store items in containers located in safe zones.
The system respects item size and container capacity.

Controls and Gamepad Support

 Added key rebinding support for mouse and keyboard.
 Added visual layouts for PS4 DualShock, PS5 DualSense, Xbox, and generic gamepads.
 Fixed an issue with camera stick controls on gamepads.

UI Improvements

 Added item stat icons instead of text.
 Added a new "Keys" category to the inventory.
 Updated skill book illustrations.
 Added a list of key story events to your run statistics.
 Various other UI fixes and improvements.

Also included:

 Dynamic chest content display
 Hero fatigue animations
 Fixes and polish based on your feedback

Localization Update:
Spark in the Dark is now available in Chinese, Hungarian, and Czech!

Thank you for supporting the project and following the development! 💀

notes.title: Spark in the Dark – Development Update & New Demo
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We’d like to share some updates on the development progress of the game.

Our main focus right now is on the development of the second and third tiers of the Dungeon. We are adding new locations, quests, and NPCs to bring our vision of the game to life.

Once these tiers are completed, we plan to launch the game in Early Access. Based on our estimates, the game will offer around 20 hours of gameplay, as the second and third tiers are larger than the first one, which is currently available in the demo.

The progress on these tiers is 80-90% complete, but we may release one more demo update before Early Access to test all the mechanics.

While we continue working on the new tiers, we have decided to release an update for the demo. It includes improvements to the first tier, as well as some gameplay adjustments.

Spark in the Dark Update 0.016
Key changes:

 Expanded locations in the first tier – new areas have been added, and some existing ones have been reworked to better fit the game’s lore and atmosphere.
 The Depth Tower has been built – an important location that will play a role in the future.
 NPC interaction added – now you can meet a character you can talk to.
 New books and notes added, along with new journal entries related to various events.
 New skill – hand-to-hand combat. You can now fight monsters without weapons. Armor type and quality affect damage output.
 Bandages added – they can be used to stop bleeding.
 Shields can now have enhancements.
 In the Nightmare Dungeon, areas tainted by darkness have appeared, capable of quickly consuming the hero without a lantern.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/c31698795e2bf01a4b4f1d8e42492fdfd5677cfc.png

Additionally:

 New sounds added and some existing ones improved.
 New ambient tracks added.
 Screen stun effect added when falling on the back.
 Improved effects for the Collider and the Ancient Warrior Statue activation.
 Two new achievements added.
 Weapon generation in treasure hoard now considers the hero’s weapon skills.
 Some weapons and armor may now be initially damaged.
 Updated some localizations and added missed strings.

Numerous small fixes and improvements have also been made.

We appreciate your feedback, ideas, and suggestions. Thank you for following the development and supporting the project!

Wishing you thrilling adventures in the darkness of Dargroth! 💀

notes.title: Steam Scream 2024 / New Patch (0.015.3)
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We've just released a new patch for the demo of Spark in the Dark (0.015.3).

This patch brings some fixes, small balance adjustments, and minor improvements based on your feedback. It also includes a new location in the Dungeon.

This update enables the "Halloween Horrors" mode during the SteamScream Festival (Oct 28 - Nov 4).

Thank you for your feedback. We read nearly everything you post on the Steam forum. Additional fixes and improvements will be coming in future patches.

Enjoy your adventures in the Dungeon!

notes.title: Halloween update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

To mark our participation in the Steam Scream: The Revenge festival we are happy to share the new update with you. It includes various fixes & minor improvements which we made for the past month. 


 Added new set of weapon inspired by nodachi and katana (two-hand sword, one-hand sword, dagger)
 Sometimes you can find scolopendra in the holes.

Added the "Halloween Horrors" mode, which will be available during the festival Steam Scream (October 26 - November 2). 

* The "Grim Tales" series of stories will be added to the game this coming weekend.

Thank you all for your feedback, ideas, and support!

notes.title: Patch for the demo (0.012.4)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The new patch adds Italian and German translations to the game.

Also:

 Updated textures and pictures of ancient shields.
 Added one more note which you can find in the dungeon.

notes.title: Spark in the Dark demo update announcement
notes.notes:
We want to share our progress with you and we are planning to update demo version at the end of December with various Dungeon & gameplay improvements. 💀

Thank you for your feedback on the first demo on Steam, it helps us develop the game!
We cannot do everything quickly, but we listen to many of your ideas and suggestions!

That's a preliminary description of the update, maybe something else will be added by then )

Statistics and achievements

Now in the hero window you can see statistics and achievements for the current game. Previously, this information was only on the final screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/c2c1637652000c7054bfee3af7e2912083531e60.png

If you find all the secret locations, this will also show up as a corresponding achievement, although until then the total number of secret locations in the level will remain unknown.

Obtaining the achievement will notify you that all secret locations have been found.
The same applies to books - the finding of all unique books on the level is now recorded as an achievement.

Light and night vision of monsters

When the hero is in the light or with the lantern on, the monsters see him with 100% vision. However, when the hero is in the dark, the monster's range of vision decreases depending on how well it sees in the dark. All monsters have different vision in the dark.

The bestiary displays information about the vision of the monsters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/5d8e000117f955259c4094e2bf12dd99a0fd9bdc.png

Heroes have a new skill Shields

It determines the effectiveness of using shields in fight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37915883/c32a0988f8afb6198fbff87b6d39ba9fabf973c8.png

For example, the Warrior has initially Shields skill = 3 and the Thief has initially Shields skill = 1.
If the Thief takes the shield and the enemy hits him with a powerful two-handed, all stamina can be taken from one blow, and the block will be knocked out in this way. But the Warrior will be able to withstand several such blows.

The skill is level up as the shields are used.

Also, weapon blocks have been improved. Removal of stamina depends on the level of possession of the weapon with which the hero is defending.
When hit in the block, the skill of the weapon is slightly increased.

Improved the system of receiving injuries

Now, getting injuries depends on the type of armor:


 For heavy armor, injuries are only obtained on a critical hit.
 For medium armor, injuries are obtained with a critical hit and a 50/50 chance for a normal hit.
 For light armor, injuries are obtained with a critical hit and a normal hit (this was the case for all armor before).
 Without armor, injuries are obtained with any hit.

If the weapon is poisoned, the poison is always applied on a critical and normal hit, regardless of the type of armor.

AND:

 Some armor can enhance a hero's Constitution.
 Different color of the blood of monsters. The weapon is dyed upon hitting the victim's corresponding color.
 Added new animations for crowbar and Ripper skill, improved some of the previous hero animations.
 The hero can carry as many lanterns and crowbars as he wants, limiting himself only to the maximum carried weight.
 The hero has new, more authentic underpants)
 Improved the mechanics of climbing and rappelling, various level improvements.
 Numerous minor improvements and bug fixes.
 Optimization, reduced peak processor loads.
 Improved English localization!

notes.title: Spark in the Dark Demo Update (patch 4)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here is a patch 4 that fixes some bugs in the demo game and contains minor balance improvements. 
 
We are happy to hear your feedback about the current demo!

Now the development of Spark in the Dark is continuing and we are returning to building the Dungeon. We are planning to create a lot of new interesting locations, mechanics and improvements in the game.

notes.title: Spark in the Dark Demo Update (patch 3)
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

We are finally happy to say that we fixed the problem with long loading of the game on Steam.
Also we made a lot of additional optimization for the past days and removed several bottlenecks.

Have fun playing in the Dungeon and thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Spark in the Dark Demo Update
notes.notes:
We have just released a small demo update that fixes the problem with long loading of the game.

There was a problem in the generation of the Dungeon and in some cases the game got into an infinite loop, which led to abnormally long loading or freezing.

Sorry for this inconvenience! We are hoping you can now return to the Dungeon and have fun playing!

Thank you for your patience!
